paragraphs.text: Though the world is subject to mutations, yet the people of God will stand sure and be defended by God's providence.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Though God permits his to be under the cross lest they embrace wickedness, yet this cross will not so rest on them, that it should drive them from hope.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: rod of the wicked shall not

paragraphs.text: He desires God to purge his Church from hypocrites and such as have no zeal for the truth.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: As for such as turn aside
